artworks.title: The East Front of the Library of Trinity College
artworks.medium: color aquatint and etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Marion F. Houstoun in memory of John Midgley
artworks.description: The image shows the East Front of the Library of Trinity College, part of the University of Cambridge. The perspective is slightly angled, showing the length of the building and creating depth. The horizon is just above a line of trees in the middle distance. The image features fine lines with attention to architectural details, typical of engraving techniques. The color palette includes soft tones of earthy browns and grays for the building and ground, contrasting with green for the grass and trees, and blues for the sky and water. A pond near the foreground reflects the college. A few figures are walking along a path winding around the pond, leading to a bridge in the distance.

artworks.title: A Donor with a Coat of Arms (Schildbegleiter und Wappenschild mit Schrägbalken)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with distinctive facial features, wearing elaborate historical or theatrical clothing. He has a large ruffled collar, a tall hat, and holds a baton or stick. The background is ornate with swirling patterns, cherubic faces, and masks. The composition includes decorative elements like columns and arches.

artworks.title: Illuminations autour du grand Canal de Versailles
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a canal surrounded by landscaped gardens. There is a gathering of people near the canal. In the distance, there is a grand architectural structure, possibly a palace. The canal is lined with rows of trees and hedges. The artwork is detailed with intricate lines and a monochrome color palette.

artworks.title: Henri, duc de Bar
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a bust portrait of a man within an oval frame. The man is facing forward with a slight turn to his right side, with a beard, mustache, and curly, receding hair. He is dressed in an elaborate period costume with a high collar and textured doublet adorned with patterns and buttons. The background includes the oval frame and a detailed hatched pattern. Text outside the oval identifies the man as "HANRY DE LORRAINE DUC DE BAR ET MAROVIS DV PONT."

artworks.title: Bon de Broé
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.7 x 13 cm (7 3/8 x 5 1/8 in.); cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man. He is facing forward with his upper torso slightly angled to the left. His face is round with pronounced cheekbones, a slightly furrowed brow, a defined nose, and thin lips. The man has short, receding hair and wears a high-collared garment under a dark outer coat that has light-colored fabric in the sleeves. The portrait is set within an oval frame with Latin text around it. In the background, there is a detailed pattern. A coat of arms is in the top right corner and there is additional text below the oval frame.

artworks.title: Anne, duc de Joyeuse
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 14.8 x 10 cm (5 13/16 x 3 15/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body facing slightly to the right with a composed expression. The individual has a mustache and a small pointed beard, wavy hair styled back and slightly upward from the face. They wear an elaborate ruffled collar and a detailed garment. An earring is visible on the left ear. In the background, there is a circular frame with text along the border, as well as more words etched outside the circle in a classical script. The tone of the portrait is formal.

artworks.title: Virgin Bowing to Instruments of the Passion
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman covered by a draped garment, with her head slightly turned downward. She has her hands over her chest. To her left, there are small figures of an infant holding an object and another figure reclining with wings on their backs. There is a simple background with a column on the left side and a lightly sketched sky on the right with cloud-like forms. Objects are at the feet of the woman.

artworks.title: C'est le portrait de Guillery...
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interaction between two figures in an outdoor setting. The drawing depicts a scene where one figure engages with another figure. The setting includes outdoor elements like vegetation, a village, and a building with a turret. The lines are detailed, and the characters are shown in dynamic postures. In the lower part of the drawing, there is a text inscription providing a narrative context for the scene.

artworks.title: Veuë de temple de Soleil à Rome (View of the Sun Temple in Rome)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with various elements placed throughout. The horizon is low, extending into the distance to reveal architectural ruins and pastoral elements. In the distance, there are structures and a tower, suggesting a historic and urban setting. The brushwork is detailed, with precise linework depicting trees, people, and animals. The color palette is black and white, highlighting the etching's details. Figures are shown tending to sheep, engaging in daily agricultural activities. Classical buildings, some in ruins, rise behind them, creating a contrast between nature and human structures. The sky above exhibits linear striations, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Travelers Approaching a Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape scene with a rocky path or bridge where two figures are walking. The bridge extends over a body of water. In the background, there are lush trees with detailed foliage. Hills and mountains can be seen in the distant horizon. The artwork is monochrome, using black, white, and gray tones to depict the textures of the clouds, foliage, and terrain.

artworks.title: Woman Painter at Easel
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated in profile view beside an artist's easel. There is a person with curly hair on the left, and another person with a headscarf on the right. The person on the left has one hand raised to their mouth, while the person on the right is drawing on the canvas. A small dog is on the floor in the foreground, and there is a window in the background casting light into the room with draped curtains.

artworks.title: Poisson en habit de Païsan
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing next to a stone column. He is looking to his right and has medium-length curly hair, a wide-brimmed hat, and is dressed in historical attire. His pose is relaxed with one hand on his hip. The background features shading resembling natural elements.

artworks.title: The Goddess Discord [La Discord]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical figures in a natural and architectural setting. The central figure is a winged being resting against a column, surrounded by columns with intricate designs and sculptures. The being looks relaxed, with a serene expression on its face. The setting includes an elaborate structure adorned with classical elements such as a frieze with the word "HYMEN" inscribed, alongside angelic figures and cherubs engaging with the central figure. To the left, the landscape includes tall trees and a distant sky. The composition is rich with symbolic elements associated with mythology and romance. The details and textures suggest a classic and ethereal atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Amorous Lion [Le lion amoureux]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image displays a woman standing in a relaxed pose with a staff. She has soft features, flowing hair, and a wide-brimmed hat. She is partially covered in patterned fabric and is accompanied by a lion. The background features a textured landscape with trees, rocks, and distant towers under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Le Mage Balthazar et Fatime
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, potentially women, depicted from the waist up. One figure is seated on a bench leaning slightly forward towards the other figure. The second figure stands next to her, one arm reaching upward and the other wrapped around the seated figure. The facial features are not clearly defined due to the sketch-like texture of the artwork. Both figures have long, flowing hair and wear draped, flowing garments. The background has a dark, textured pattern, suggesting a natural or outdoor setting. There is subtle light indicating either dawn or dusk. The figures do not hold any objects or wear jewelry.

artworks.title: Tobias Burying One of the Children of Israel
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is an image depicting a group of people interacting with each other outdoors. The scene shows four figures engaging in conversation, with one seated and the others standing around making gestures. The figures are dressed in period clothing, suggesting a historical or biblical context. In the background, there are architectural structures, including a building with an archway and a round structure. Lush foliage and trees provide a natural backdrop. The drawing style includes detailed line work and shading for depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 20.2 x 15.4 cm (7 15/16 x 6 1/16 in.); cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a central object. The drawing features a detailed study of expressions and interactions, with the focus on a candle held by an older figure with curly hair and a thick beard. The figures appear to be sharing a moment of contemplation or discussion, looking downward toward outlines of a baby. The background is detailed with inscriptions that add context to the scene. The scene captures an atmosphere of intimacy and focus, and the draftsmanship emphasizes the texture and expressions of the characters involved.

artworks.title: A Pike-Man Turned to the Left
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing confidently. He is positioned with one hand on his hip and the other holding a tall, ornate staff. The man has an angular face with a prominent nose and a short beard; his hair is short and curly. He wears an elaborate outfit typical of the late 16th to early 17th century, featuring a ruffled collar, a decorated doublet, and puffed, patterned sleeves, paired with knee-length breeches and stockings. He has a sword attached at his side. There is a detailed shield with a crest hanging from a tree to his right, and the background shows a landscape with trees and distant figures engaged in a battle scene, with smoke and clouds suggesting the chaos of warfare. The bottom part of the image features Latin text.

artworks.title: The Three Graces
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in an intricate pose, partially draped in fabric. One person stands in the center with their back to the viewer, while the other two face each other. They have detailed facial features and braided updos, holding decorative wreaths above their heads. The background has swirling cloud forms.

artworks.title: Without Ceres and Bacchus, Venus Would Freeze
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures celebrating abundance. The drawing depicts four figures in a classical setting, surrounded by symbols of prosperity such as grapes and a large tree. An infant points toward the figure with a cornucopia, indicating the sharing of abundance, while another figure appears to hold a cup aloft in a gesture of toast or offering. In the background, rolling hills and classical architectural elements add depth to the scene. The chiaroscuro technique is employed to accentuate the musculature and drapery of the figures.

artworks.title: Avarice
artworks.artist: attributed to Jacob Matham, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person standing with a slight lean, carrying various objects in their arms. The person's face is turned to the side, wearing a cloth wrapped around their head. They are wearing a long garment with pouches tied around the torso and arms, and appear to be barefoot. The person is holding scrolls and small sacks. The background includes outdoor elements like rolling hills, trees, and a small building in the distance. A small animal is near the person's feet. The sky is filled with swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Raising of Lazarus with Scenes from the Life of Christ
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This drawing features a series of interconnected scenes within architectural spaces. The central oval frame contains a highly detailed interior with various figures engaged in activities around a central figure. Additional vignettes surrounding the central scene also depict different narratives with their own set of figures. The composition is intricate, with detailed line work creating depth and texture. Architectural elements like columns and stairs help guide the viewer's eye through the various events depicted.

artworks.title: Law of War and Peace
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an architectural scene. Classical elements like columns and a banner with the text "HVG. GROTII / DE IVRE BELLI AC PACIS / LIBRI TRES" are featured. Three figures are central: one muscular person, a female figure holding tablets, and a figure with a radiant head. Other figures are engaged in various actions, including a scene with an animal and two people near a fire or altar with scrolls. The drawing's intricate lines and textures show attention to detail, emphasizing depth and drama, typical of period engravings.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Antiope
artworks.artist: Willem Panneels after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two figures and a large bird. The central figure is a seated woman with long, curly hair, wearing a cloth and an armlet. Behind her, a bearded man leans towards her with a hand raised. A large bird, possibly a swan, is present, with wings spread. Foliage is visible at the bottom right corner, and the background has a textured appearance with lines suggesting movement or a sky.
